sections.title: List of taxes and charges in Sweden

rows.label: Personal income tax (statlig inkomstskatt) [national]
rows.value: 20% state income tax on taxable earned income above SEK 643,000, plus municipal tax (see A3). Paid by resident individuals. Inkomstskattelagen (1999:1229).

source.title: Skatteverket: Belopp och procent – inkomstår 2026

rows.label: Municipal income tax (kommunalskatt and regionskatt) [municipal]
rows.value: Average 32.38% in 2026 (municipality 20.69% + region 11.69%); set by each of the 290 municipalities and 21 regions (see the county pages). Paid by resident individuals. Rates set by each municipality and region, published by SCB.

source.title: SCB (Statistics Sweden): Kommunalskatterna 2026

rows.label: Church fee (kyrkoavgift) and burial fee [municipal]
rows.value: Church fee set by each parish for members of the Church of Sweden; burial fee 0.292% for everyone registered in Sweden (other rates in Stockholm and Tranås). Paid by members of the Church of Sweden (church fee); all residents (burial fee). Begravningslagen; lagen om avgift till registrerat trossamfund.

source.title: Skatteverket: Belopp och procent – inkomstår 2026

rows.label: Capital gains and capital income tax (skatt på kapitalinkomster) [national]
rows.value: 30% on capital income and gains; investment savings accounts taxed on a standard income (1.065% effective above SEK 300,000 in 2026). Paid by individuals. Inkomstskattelagen.

source.title: Skatteverket: Belopp och procent – inkomstår 2026 (Schablonintäkt på investeringssparkonto; Schablonintäkt på fondandelar; Skattereduktion vid underskott av kapital; Försäljning näringsfastighet)

rows.label: Withholding tax on dividends (kupongskatt) [national]
rows.value: 30% on dividends to recipients living abroad, lowered by tax treaties. Paid by non-resident shareholders (withheld by the paying company). Kupongskattelagen (1970:624).

source.title: Skatteverket: För dig som betalar svensk kupongskatt på utdelning; Kupongskatt

rows.label: Rental income from a private home (uthyrning av privatbostad) [national]
rows.value: SEK 40,000 standard deduction per home and year; the surplus is capital income taxed at 30%. Paid by individuals who let their home. Inkomstskattelagen.

source.title: Skatteverket: Hyra ut privatbostad – bostadsrätt, småhus och hyresrätt

rows.label: Non-resident tax on employment income (SINK) [national]
rows.value: 22.5% flat tax on Swedish pay (15% on seamen's income); or the ordinary rules at the average municipal rate of 32.38%, with allowances where at least 90% of earned income is from Sweden. Paid by non-resident employees (withheld by the payer). Lagen (1991:586) om särskild inkomstskatt för utomlands bosatta.

source.title: Skatteverket: Belopp och procent – inkomstår 2026

rows.label: Social security contributions (arbetsgivaravgifter and allmän pensionsavgift) [national]
rows.value: Employer contributions 31.42%; employees' general pension contribution 7% of earned income (at most SEK 47,100), credited against tax. Paid by employers and employees. Socialavgiftslagen (2000:980); lagen om allmän pensionsavgift.

source.title: Skatteverket: Belopp och procent – inkomstår 2026

rows.label: Payroll tax on pension costs (särskild löneskatt) [national]
rows.value: 24.26% on employers' pension costs and on contributions to profit-sharing foundations. Paid by employers. Lagen (1991:687) om särskild löneskatt på pensionskostnader.

source.title: Skatteverket: Belopp och procent – inkomstår 2026

rows.label: Self-employed contributions (egenavgifter) [national]
rows.value: 28.97% of the contribution base; 7.5% reduction (at most SEK 15,000) for active business. Paid by sole traders and partners. Socialavgiftslagen.

source.title: Skatteverket: Egenavgifter och särskild löneskatt; Belopp och procent – inkomstår 2026 (Egenavgift)

rows.label: Contractor or employee: F-skatt approval and 30% withholding [national]
rows.value: No withholding on payments to contractors approved for F-skatt; otherwise tax withheld (30% for companies, side income, one-off and short assignments) and employer contributions for individuals. Paid by payers of fees for work. Skatteförfarandelagen (2011:1244).

source.title: Skatteverket: F-skatt och FA-skatt

rows.label: Corporate income tax (bolagsskatt) [national]
rows.value: 20.6%; 15% global minimum tax for groups with revenue of at least EUR 750 million. Paid by companies and other legal persons. Inkomstskattelagen; lag (2023:875) om tilläggsskatt.

source.title: Skatteverket: Belopp och procent – inkomstår 2026

rows.label: Simplified regime for small businesses: VAT exemption up to SEK 120,000 [national]
rows.value: No VAT registration needed for annual turnover up to SEK 120,000; egenavgifter reduced by 7.5% (at most SEK 15,000) for active business. Paid by small businesses (optional). Mervärdesskattelagen.

source.title: Skatteverket: I vissa fall behöver du inte registrera ditt företag för moms

rows.label: Value added tax (moms) [national]
rows.value: 25% standard; 12% and 6% reduced rates (food 6% from 1 April 2026 to 31 December 2027). Paid by consumers (collected by registered businesses). Mervärdesskattelagen (2023:200).

source.title: Skatteverket: Momssatser och undantag från moms; Riksdagen: Skatteutskottets betänkande 2025/26:SkU9 (Tillfälligt sänkt mervärdesskatt på livsmedel)

rows.label: Excise duties (punktskatter) on tobacco, alcohol and fuel [national]
rows.value: Cigarettes SEK 2.08 each + 1% of retail price; spirits SEK 526.97 per litre of pure alcohol; petrol energy tax SEK 1.52 per litre (December 2026). Paid by consumers (paid by producers and importers). Lagen om tobaksskatt; lagen om alkoholskatt; lagen om skatt på energi.

source.title: Skatteverket: Skattesatser för tobak

rows.label: Electricity tax (energiskatt på el) [national]
rows.value: 36.0 öre per kWh in 2026 (9.6 öre less in parts of northern Sweden). Paid by electricity consumers. Lagen (1994:1776) om skatt på energi.

source.title: Skatteverket: Skatt på el

rows.label: Property tax: municipal property fee and state property tax [national]
rows.value: Small houses 0.75% of assessed value, at most SEK 10,425; apartments SEK 1,784 each or 0.3%; commercial premises 1%; industry 0.5%. Paid by property owners on 1 January. Lagen (2007:1398) om kommunal fastighetsavgift; lagen (1984:1052) om statlig fastighetsskatt.

source.title: Skatteverket: Fastighetsavgift och fastighetsskatt

rows.label: Property transfer: stamp duty (stämpelskatt) on title and mortgages [national]
rows.value: 1.5% for individuals and 4.25% for legal persons on the higher of price and assessed value; 2% on new mortgage deeds. Paid by the buyer or borrower. Lag (1984:404) om stämpelskatt vid inskrivningsmyndigheter.

source.title: Sveriges riksdag: Lag (1984:404) om stämpelskatt vid inskrivningsmyndigheter (ändrad t.o.m. SFS 2025:391)

rows.label: Wealth tax (förmögenhetsskatt): none [national]
rows.value: None: the Act on state wealth tax was repealed from 1 January 2008. Paid by no one. Lag (1997:323) om statlig förmögenhetsskatt, repealed by SFS 2007:1403.

source.title: Sveriges riksdag: Lag (1997:323) om statlig förmögenhetsskatt (Upphävd 2008-01-01)

rows.label: Inheritance and gift tax (arvsskatt och gåvoskatt): none [national]
rows.value: None: the Act on inheritance and gift tax was repealed from 1 January 2005. Paid by no one. Lag (1941:416) om arvsskatt och gåvoskatt, repealed by SFS 2004:1341.

source.title: Sveriges riksdag: Lag (1941:416) om arvsskatt och gåvoskatt (Upphävd 2005-01-01)

rows.label: Vehicle tax (fordonsskatt) [national]
rows.value: SEK 360 a year plus SEK 22 per g CO2/km above 111 g for cars taxed by emissions; motorcycles SEK 180. Paid by vehicle owners. Vägtrafikskattelagen (2006:227).

source.title: Transportstyrelsen: Skattens storlek (fordonsskatt)

rows.label: Carbon dioxide tax (koldioxidskatt) [national]
rows.value: SEK 3.27 per litre of petrol from 1 December 2026 (lower rates earlier in 2026). Paid by fuel consumers (paid by suppliers). Lagen (1994:1776) om skatt på energi.

source.title: Skatteverket: Skatt på bränsle (skattesatser 2026)

rows.label: Air passenger tax (flygskatt): none since 1 July 2025 [national]
rows.value: None: the Act on tax on air travel ceased to apply on 1 July 2025. Paid by no one. Lagen (2017:1200) om skatt på flygresor, repealed.

source.title: Skatteverket: Flygskatt

rows.label: Customs: EU customs duty, import VAT, handling fee and traveller allowances [EU and national]
rows.value: EUR 3 per item on parcels up to EUR 150; EUR 2 handling fee from 1 November 2026; 25% import VAT (6% food); allowances SEK 5,000 (air and ferry) and SEK 3,500. Paid by importers and travellers. EU Customs Code; tullagen (2016:253); mervärdesskattelagen.

source.title: Tullverket: Om tullar och avgifter när du handlar på nätet (sidan uppdaterades 2026-11-01)

rows.label: Stamp duty on documents: stämpelskatt on title registration and mortgage deeds [national]
rows.value: 1.5% or 4.25% of the property value; 2% of new mortgage deeds; at least SEK 50. Paid by the party applying for registration. Lag (1984:404) om stämpelskatt vid inskrivningsmyndigheter.

source.title: Sveriges riksdag: Lag (1984:404) om stämpelskatt vid inskrivningsmyndigheter (ändrad t.o.m. SFS 2025:391)

rows.label: Broadcasting fee (public service-avgift) [national]
rows.value: 1% of taxable earned income, at most SEK 1,184 in 2026. Paid by individuals aged 18 or over. Lagen (2018:1893) om finansiering av radio och tv i allmänhetens tjänst.

source.title: Skatteverket: Teknisk beskrivning för skattetabeller 2026, SKV 433 utgåva 36 (dated 2025-12-10), section 7.6 Public service-avgiften

rows.label: Expat regime: expert tax relief for foreign key employees (expertskatt) [national]
rows.value: 25% of income exempt for up to 7 years. Paid by foreign experts, researchers and key people approved by Forskarskattenämnden. Inkomstskattelagen 11 kap. 22–23 §§.

source.title: Forskarskattenämnden (Swedish Research Tax Board): Om skattelättnad

rows.label: Surcharge on income tax: none since 2020 (värnskatt) [national]
rows.value: None: the state income tax on earned income is a single 20% step above the threshold; the upper 5% step (värnskatt) was abolished from 1 January 2020. Paid by no one. Inkomstskattelag (1999:1229), 65 kap. 5 §; Finansdepartementet, promemoria Fi2019/02421/S1.

rows.value: None by law: occupational pensions are paid by the employer under a collective agreement between employers and trade unions or an individual contract; not every employer offers one (about 9 in 10 employees are covered). Paid by no one by law (employers under collective agreements). Pensionsmyndigheten, Det här är tjänstepension.

rows.value: None: municipal and regional taxation is limited to the residents' earned income (kommunalskatt and regionskatt). Paid by no one. Regeringsformen 14 kap. 4 §; Inkomstskattelag (1999:1229); SOU 2026:20, chapter 2.

rows.label: Tax on distributed profits paid abroad: dividend withholding tax for non-resident shareholders (kupongskatt) [national]
rows.value: 30% of dividends distributed by Swedish companies to non-resident individuals and foreign legal persons, unless attributable to a Swedish permanent establishment; EU parent companies holding 10% or more of the capital are exempt. Paid by non-resident shareholders (withheld by the paying company or nominee). Kupongskattelag (1970:624), 4 and 5 §§.

source.title: Sveriges riksdag: Kupongskattelag (1970:624), 4 and 5 §§ (amended up to SFS 2026:840)

rows.label: Local sales tax: none [municipal]
rows.value: None: municipal and regional taxation is limited to the residents' earned income; VAT and excise duties are state taxes. Paid by no one. Regeringsformen 14 kap. 4 §; SOU 2026:20, chapter 2.

rows.value: 32% of the earned premium for compulsory motor third-party (traffic) insurance covering risks in Sweden, and 22% of the traffic insurance fee for uninsured vehicles. Paid by insurers (passed on in premiums). Lag (2007:460) om skatt på trafikförsäkringspremie m.m., 1, 3 and 10 §§.

rows.value: 32% of the earned premium for compulsory motor third-party (traffic) insurance covering risks in Sweden, and 22% of the traffic insurance fee for uninsured vehicles. Paid by insurers (passed on in premiums). Lag (2007:460) om skatt på trafikförsäkringspremie m.m., 1, 3 and 10 §§.

rows.label: Tourist tax: none (turistskatt) [national and municipal]
rows.value: None: no tourist tax or tourist fee is levied; the Minister for Finance stated in February 2020 that no proposal for one was being prepared. Paid by no one. Svar på fråga 2019/20:819 och 2019/20:833.
